title: Far and Away

outfit_card.silhouette: Empire-waist babydoll dress with a high-busted red velvet overbodice flaring into petal panels over a full white tulle skirt, finished with sheer puff sleeves and a delicate bow at the center front.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Oversized red-and-gold plaid bow headpiece with a small jeweled crown at its center, paired with a fine choker necklace for a coquettish, storybook finishing touch.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Square-neck red velvet bodice with scalloped hem, sheer white organza puff sleeves with ruffled lace cuffs, and a gold ribbon bow with trailing tails at the center front accented by tiny pearl buttons.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered white tulle skirt with soft gathered tiers, gold ribbon streamers falling from the waist, sheer white lace stockings, and white bow-festooned gloves finishing the ensemble.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Sheer white lace gloves with ribbon wrist ties, scattered starry sparkles, and a small plaid bow motif echoing the headpiece for a sweet, fantasy-themed look.
